title: Kenyan Strawberry Passion Smoothie
community: Urban Kenya — the café fruit smoothie
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Strawberry Passion Smoothie — Kenyan highlands strawberries blended with fresh passion fruit, natural yogurt, honey, and banana. The fruit partnership that defines Kenyan smoothie culture — tart passion fruit balanced by sweet strawberry.
longDesc: The Kenyan highlands — particularly around Limuru and Kiambu — produce exceptional strawberries. Combined with the extraordinary passion fruit from the same region, they create a smoothie of unusual complexity and beauty. The yogurt adds creaminess and probiotics; the banana adds body.
ingredients: ½ cup milk or coconut milk
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Garnish with a strawberry and passion fruit half.
chefTips: Kenyan highlands strawberries are smaller and more intensely flavoured than commercial varieties — use them.
The passion fruit seeds can be left in for texture or strained out for smoothness.
commonMistakes: Over-sweetening — the natural fruit sugars should be prominent.
cookingScience: Strawberry colour comes from anthocyanins and ellagitannins — the same class of antioxidants found in hibiscus. The yogurt's lactic acid slightly brightens the colour through the same pH-sensitivity mechanism.
sustainabilityTips: Kenyan highlands strawberries and passion fruit — locally grown with minimal food miles.
healthBenefits: Strawberries are extremely high in vitamin C.
Passion fruit adds more vitamin C and fibre.
culturalNote: Strawberry passion smoothie celebrates the extraordinary fruit production of Kenya's Central highlands — a region that produces both world-class strawberries and world-class passion fruit within the same cool, fertile landscape.
